record.question: The number one cause of kidney failure is:
record.explanation: Answer C: Diabetes Mellitus. In India, diabetes/diabetic kidney disease is identified as the leading cause of CKD; the Government of India CKD guideline and Indian CKD Registry support diabetes as the best answer. Reference: https://www.mohfw.gov.in/sites/default/files/Fin%20-%20CKD%20guidelines.pdf; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3350459/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
